idempotency.description: Unique identifier that represents the operation

name.description: The name of the client organization
Unique name within a client org that identifies the notification

subject.description: The subject line seen by the member before clicking into the notification

body.description: The body of the notification message seen by the member upon selection

trigger.description: Indicates if the notification is triggered by a date or an event via webhook.

triggerDate.description: Setting the date that the notification will be triggered. Date must be a future date

recipientType.description: Defines the population parameters for the notification

frequency.description: Determines if the notification will only be sent one time, or if the notification can be sent each time the trigger occurs

accountType.description: Specifies the account types receiving the notification when ‘Recipient Type’ is ‘Account Type’.

eventName.description: Specifies the Lynx event initiating the notification

idempotencyKey.description: Unique identifier that represents the operation
